note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The decision carries ONLY editable placeholder text (numbered placeholder sections); the two labels are neutral labels supplied by the party, of equal weight; a line means only that the party attached that label to that section (as supplied). No grounds catalogue, admissibility, time limit, standard of review, evaluation of any section, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn.
